messages:
emily-cs: FYI customer reports checkout traces showing request ids but child spans missing in trace view for several rqids (example: 8f3a7b2c). They see the spans in raw events but the trace graph is empty. I copied a sample rqid and raw payload.
mara-support: Thanks — can you paste one sample rqid and any links/screenshots? Customer said it started ~15:00 UTC.
emily-cs: sample rqid=8f3a7b2c. Screenshot: https://files.internal/snap/8f3a7b2c.png . Raw event snippet inline below.
raj-eng: paste the raw sample please (headers + envelope). quick check: is this for a specific tenant or all tenants?
emily-cs: tenant id=cloud-retail-prod. raw event (sanitized):
```
{ "envelope": "envelope_v2", "meta": { "ids": { "rid": "8f3a7b2c" } }, "spans": [{"id":"s1","parent":"root","name":"checkout.pay"}] }
```
emily-cs: customer says console search for request_id:8f3a7b2c returns nothing, but raw events explorer shows the document above.
sasha-observability: ah. we pushed the envelope_v2 indexing change last night. mapping now places request ids at meta.ids.rid rather than top-level request_id. console search still queries request_id path. that would explain it.
raj-eng: confirming. ran a quick ES query against index for tenant cloud-retail-prod:
```
GET /traces-cloud-retail-prod/_search
{ "query": { "term": { "meta.ids.rid": "8f3a7b2c" } } }
```
result: document present with spans array populated. the console's trace-lookup service does:
```
term: request_id:8f3a7b2c
```
so mismatch between ingest mapping and lookup key.
tom-oncall: summary: ingestion started writing rqids to nested path in envelope_v2; lookup expects flat request_id. Is this a deliberate mapping change or regression?
sasha-observability: it was deliberate to support multiple ids, but we overlooked backward-compat for the console lookup alias. pipeline PR added envelope_v2 branch but didn't populate request_id alias.
mara-support: customer impact: unknown delta number, but CloudRetail sees ~10% of checkout traces affected since deploy window. they want ETA and a workaround.
raj-eng: short term workaround: console supports raw query param to search nested path. instruct customer to use raw explorer query: `meta.ids.rid:<id>` or use our tracing API: `/v1/traces/search?field=meta.ids.rid&q=8f3a7b2c`.
longer term: two options:
- quick hotfix: update ingest pipeline to copy meta.ids.rid -> request_id for envelope_v2 and restart indexer (non-destructive), then update mapping alias; this will make console queries work again for new events.
- backfill: reindex documents from the last N hours to populate request_id for historical events (we can reindex 48h window).
tom-oncall: plan: ship hotfix to pipeline in 2h (patch PR already in draft), then run backfill for last 48h starting after hotfix. estimate backfill complete ~12h after start (depends on tenant volume).
mara-support: can we give CloudRetail a temporary search snippet to find their traces? also need a customer-facing note about root cause.
emily-cs: I sent them the raw search snippet and told them we have a hotfix queued. awaiting confirmation to schedule backfill.
ingest-bot: reindex job queued: job_id=rj-2026-03-17-01 (auto created by ops). ETA start: after hotfix.
raj-eng: PR: https://git.internal/rp/ingest/pull/412 — adds a pipeline step to copy `meta.ids.rid` -> `request_id` when envelope == "envelope_v2". I'll request review and can cut a patch release if approvals come through.
tom-oncall: I'll own rollout and monitoring. will post status updates here. if any tenant shows spike in errors after patch we rollback.
mara-support: thanks. I'll update CloudRetail with workaround + ETA. can we also log how many docs were affected so we can include impact in the summary?
raj-eng: yes, I'll produce a quick count after hotfix using:
```
GET /traces-cloud-retail-prod/_count
{ "query": { "bool": { "must": [ { "exists": { "field": "meta.ids.rid" } }, { "bool": { "must_not": { "exists": { "field": "request_id" } } } } ] } } }
```
will share numbers once job completes.
emily-cs: customer updated — thanks, they can use raw query for now. marking high priority. :white_check_mark:
note: thread conforms to slack agents.md: short messages, participants listed, payload is single continuous string of messages prefixed by sender
